pass_rule: A named scope can PASS only when every applicable required criterion is PASS with actual evidence. Any applicable FAIL, BLOCKED or NOT_RUN forbids scope PASS. NOT_APPLICABLE requires a specific reviewed reason. VA-25 passing only means honest issue reporting and never clears the issues it records. A lobby pass does not pass game art/G5/G6.
